thesis.title: Evidence Before Interpretation
thesis.argument: Source custody and independent judgment are two separate obligations.
thesis.mechanism: A record of what was said remains distinct from a reasoned interpretation of its meaning.
thesis.counterargument: Low-risk video reviews need not all receive expensive external research.
thesis.implication: Scale adjudication effort to consequence, but never invent certainty.
